name: Human Rights Campaign
notes: Human Rights Campaign Congressional Scorecard, 119th Congress (2025 to date), scores on LGBTQ+ equality votes and cosponsorships, 0 to 100 percent, read from the published PDF (the only per-member listing; the HRC web page just links to it). Collected with WebFetch on the PDF, which returned the Senate table in full (100 rows) and the House tables for Alabama through Texas district 28; the fetched text is cut off after Texas 28, so House members from Texas district 29 onward (Texas 29 to 38, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming) and delegates (DC, territories) are missing, and offset did not reach past the cut. The PDF reader summarised the tables, so values were read in several passes; Senate rows were consistent across passes. Matched by chamber, state, district and last name. 'N/A' in the scorecard (newly seated or vacant-seat members not eligible) stored as null. Ohio 14 Joyce (6) came from run-together text in the PDF and is moderately confident; Ohio 15 Carey was skipped as ambiguous (text read '36 N/A'; likely 3). The PDF also shows 118th and 117th scores for some members but no lifetime score, so lifetime is null for everyone. Vacant rows (FL-20, TX-23) skipped.
